title: mRemoteNG.exe process is not terminated after I close the window
author: zgabi
body_snippet:
It still shown in the taskmanager minutes after I close the program.
Normally it is not a problem for me, since i close it very rarely, but now when I always upgrade to the latest nightly I have to kill it every time.

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Hey @zgabi! 👋

Great catch — especially annoying when you're upgrading to every nightly! 😄

**Root cause:** Two threads (`SaveConnectionsAsync` and `LoadConnectionsAsync`) were created as **foreground threads** (the default in .NET). The CLR won't terminate the process until ALL foreground threads finish.
